subject.title: [Feature Request]: Multi-lane concurrency support for sub-agents via sessions_spawn

question: Should OpenClaw expose caller-selectable `sessions_spawn` lanes, and if so must lane names be predeclared with per-lane caps under one aggregate sub-agent budget?
rationale: This feature adds model-facing scheduling control and a new compatibility-sensitive configuration surface; the safe lane identity, precedence, and total-cap policy cannot be inferred mechanically from the existing single-lane behavior.

options.title: Bounded configured lanes
options.body: Add a validated `lane` selector that may reference only configured sub-agent lanes, preserves `subagent` by default, and retains an aggregate cap across all sub-agent work.

options.title: Keep one shared sub-agent pool
options.body: Retain the existing scalar concurrency control and address priority or observability through separate scheduling work instead of exposing arbitrary lanes.

options.title: Use per-agent limits instead
options.body: Prioritize per-agent concurrency policy so a selected target agent is constrained without introducing general-purpose caller-selected lanes.

recommendation.title: Bounded configured lanes
recommendation.body: Add a validated `lane` selector that may reference only configured sub-agent lanes, preserves `subagent` by default, and retains an aggregate cap across all sub-agent work.

likelyOwner.reason: The current and historical sub-agent spawn/concurrency paths are most directly associated with this person.
